run_requirements.model: operator-chosen; MODEL and EVAL_MODEL are empty in example.env and the deep evaluator hard-errors without one
run_requirements.judge_calls_per_task: Deep only: one judge call per (ground_truth_title x candidate_title) pair; max_candidates_per_pass defaults to 1, so ~1 judge call per deep task per pass, x K_PASSES x stochastic_repeats (protocol sets 3). Wide uses no LLM judge (deterministic set IoU).
run_requirements.estimated_scale: 1000 tasks (600 deep + 400 wide). Inference dominates: MAX_TURNS defaults to 10 agent turns per task, each turn issuing an agent LLM call plus tool calls whose summarisers are themselves LLM calls. One full pass over one system is order 1e4 agent LLM calls plus a comparable number of search-summariser calls, before multiplying by 6 baselines + 6 ablations + ORION x 3 repeats.
run_requirements.hard_blocker: PAPER_SEARCH_API_URL is empty in example.env and the default SEARCH_TOOL=deepxiv resolves to tool_deepxivsearch.py, which targets a paper-search service the repository does not publish. The official inference route cannot be reproduced without a paper-search backend that is not distributed with the benchmark. Paid LLM keys (agent + judge) and Serper/Jina keys are additionally required and are not available to this audit.

artifacts.contamination_note: Evaluator and metrics are in-repo and deterministic for Wide; Deep depends on an LLM judge whose model identity must be frozen in the run manifest. See the dataset record for question/answer exposure.

Separately: gold labels (answer, arxiv_id) ship in the same records as the questions, so the protocol's access_policy.hidden_labels guarantee must be enforced by the harness rather than inherited from the benchmark. See evidence/access/contamination_probes.md.

pinned_revision_integrity.verdict: No P0. Every 40-character SHA in PROTOCOL_V1.json reference_revisions resolves at its named repository, and all four repositories are public and unarchived.

cross_cutting_findings: Two of the four pinned code repositories (HughieHu/Sage, OxRML/AgentSLR) carry no licence at any depth of their pinned trees, so JOURNAL_READINESS section 8 'frozen corpora/index snapshots where redistribution permits' cannot be satisfied for them.
The SAGE task family (sage_scientific_retrieval) has neither a published retrieval corpus nor an official evaluator, so it cannot be executed as specified regardless of licensing or budget.
Every remaining external family requires paid third-party LLM credentials that this audit does not hold; AutoResearchBench additionally requires an unpublished paper-search backend.

AutoResearchBench's obfuscation is key-less and locally reversible, and its gold labels ship inside the same records as the questions, so PROTOCOL_V1.json access_policy.hidden_labels must be enforced by the ORION harness rather than assumed from the benchmark.
SAGE's gold set is public plaintext and web-indexed, making any live-provider SAGE result contaminated by construction.
